verdict.rationale: A Secretary of State business registry could plausibly publish bulk registry extracts or datasets, so the axis applies. The pack contains only robots.txt probes: one 403, and bot-challenge interstitials from Akamai/Incapsula on the main site and the ORION filing portal. None of them documents any bulk download, extract, or dataset offering.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
